:::{#exr-matrix-row-practice}
#### Reading off a row of a matrix

When each [row of a matrix](#def-matrix-row) records one observation,
reading off a [row](#def-matrix-row) extracts every measured quantity for that one observation.
Let

$$
\matr{D} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -4 & 2 \\ 0 & 6 & 3 \\ 5 & 5 & -1 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

Find $\matr{D}_{3,:}$, the third [row of $\matr{D}$](#def-matrix-row).

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

A [row of a matrix](#def-matrix-row) lists the entries $a_{i1}, \ldots, a_{in}$ from left to right,
as in @exm-matrix-rows-columns.

:::
